description: R-PAR-1 PAR-FOLD, SQL-AGG-SINGLE, SQL-AGG-NUMERIC: What exact Double bits do Var, VarP, StDev and StDevP give per FL group (g1 to g3, about 4100 rows each) as GROUP BY g over FL and over FLI, and through a derived table of g2 ordered by d, d DESC and id DESC, and of g1 ordered by id DESC? Runs on a fresh copy of r-par-1-fold2 opened read-only through DAO OpenDatabase in one process and one STA; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, and every call's result, HRESULT and DBEngine.Errors are captured.
retentionNote: Designed r-par-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
